texts: Surgery for a type I, sliding, hiatal hernia is indicated by its complications.
Severe symptoms despite maximal medical therapy, an oesophageal stricture, recurrent aspiration and high-grade dysplasia are all indications.
The amount of stomach in the chest, even more than half, is not an indication by itself: C is the answer.
Memory hook: the line 50 on the pot is not a reason; the pinched slide, the soup in the sacks, the thrown-away pump and the dark staves are.
